bio: Hardware & Locomotion Lead @TorqueDynamicsSG. Designing high-torque-density quasi-direct-drive (QDD) actuators & whole-body MPC + RL controllers for bipedal inspection robots.
discovered_via: SEG-01: SEA Embodied AI & Robotics Founders

recent_posts.text: Benchmarked our rev-4 planetary QDD knee actuator on the dynamometer today: 120 Nm peak torque at 980g mass, backdrivable with <0.18 Nm friction torque, and held thermal equilibrium at 62°C during 45-min stair-climbing RL policy rollouts.
